ai_summary: Ashika Global Securities Ltd reported a strong H1FY27 with a Profit After Tax of ₹118.08 crore and a healthy 20.20% Return on Equity, driven by significant operational expansion across its diversified financial services platform. Key achievements include the successful first closes for Private Equity and Private Credit funds, a credit rating upgrade for a material subsidiary, and strategic advancements in digital transformation and new fund launches, positioning the company for sustained growth with no material red flags evident in this performance release.
